📝 Walkthrough ## Walkthrough The PR removes the `ClusterBreadcrumbs` component and refactors navigation patterns across the assisted installer UI. Masthead logos are now made clickable with navigation to cluster lists, and breadcrumb rendering is replaced by conditional header display controlled via a `showHeader` prop in `ClusterPage`. ## Changes |Cohort / File(s)|Summary| |---|---| |**Logo Navigation Updates**
`apps/assisted-disconnected-ui/src/components/App.tsx`, `apps/assisted-ui/src/components/Header.tsx`|Enhanced masthead logos with click-to-navigate functionality using `Link` component, routing to a dynamically constructed `/clusters` path derived from `Config.routeBasePath`.| |**Breadcrumb Component Removal**
`libs/ui-lib/lib/ocm/components/clusters/ClusterBreadcrumbs.tsx`|Deleted entire `ClusterBreadcrumbs` component that previously rendered navigation breadcrumbs with conditional "Cluster List" and cluster-name crumbs.| |**Breadcrumb Usage Cleanup**
`libs/ui-lib/lib/ocm/components/clusters/ClusterPage.tsx`, `Clusters.tsx`, `NewClusterPage.tsx`|Removed all `ClusterBreadcrumbs` imports and renderings; refactored `ClusterPage` to replace `showBreadcrumbs` prop with `showHeader` prop and conditionally render `AssistedInstallerHeader`; removed `NewSingleClusterPage` export.| ## Estimated code review effort 🎯 3 (Moderate) | ⏱️ ~25 minutes ## Possibly related PRs - [`#3293`](https://github.com/openshift-assisted/assisted-installer-ui/pull/3293) — Modifies `AssistedInstallerHeader` component implementation that is now integrated into `ClusterPage` via the new `showHeader` prop. ## Suggested labels `lgtm`, `approved` ## Suggested reviewers - celdrake - ElayAharoni - jgyselov ## Poem > 🐰 Logo clicks now guide the way, > Breadcrumbs fade to yesterday, > Headers rise where crumbs once stood, > Navigation's understood! > Routes flow, refactored through— > Cleaner paths for me and you! ✨
